title: Ritham Health-Intake Questionnaire & Condition-Based Recommendation Rules
summary: Defines the health screening questionnaire flow, condition tags, and rule tables governing workout/nutrition personalization gating and disclaimers.
notes: Ambiguous between PRD and SPEC: document has strong feature/requirement language (user-facing questionnaire flow, UX copy, disclaimers) typical of a PRD, but is dominated by precise rule tables, gate legends, condition-tag data model, and explicit trigger/threshold logic (Sections 2, 3, 5) that function as implementation contracts, which is more SPEC-like. Classified as SPEC per precedence (SPEC > PRD) given the rule-table/data-model density, but synthesizer should treat requirement-like sections (1.0-1.6, Section 4 UX copy) as PRD-equivalent content if needed.
